tuition.notes: University of Toronto 2026-27 Tuition Fee Report (Planning & Budget; 'CURRENT TUITION FEE SCHEDULE' link on planningandbudget.utoronto.ca/tuition-ancilliary-fees/tuition-fees/). Table D2 columns: 2025-26, 2026-27 (APPROVAL) and 2027-28 (INFO). The 2027 cohort's first-year fee is CAD 68,750 in 2027-28, the same as the general Arts & Science direct-entry rate in Table D1 ('Bachelors, Entering 2027 NA NA $68,750'); upper years of Computer Science carry the higher CS rate (2026 cohort: $72,480 in 2027-28). The report: 'The University provides a supplemental schedule of currently planned fees for 2027-28 for information only ... Note that these fees are subject to change when the University finalizes its plans next year.' So this is a planned, not an approved, 2027/28 fee. The approved 2026-27 first-year fee (2026 cohort) is CAD 66,110. The registrar's per-college fee schedules (registrar.utoronto.ca/fees-payments/tuition-fee-schedules/) still list 2025-26 as the latest. Excludes incidental/ancillary fees and UHIP.
